row.title: CLONE-PATH-1: a copied template starts from one form and one link
row.body: Lesson: a start path is only walked when a test walks it as a person with no developer skill. Found that way: gate cards naming keys to set, a README of terminal commands, a red run for every copy with no hosting sign-in, the template example staffed as the owner's idea, the interview's IDEA.md turned away as not a fit, kernel tests failing once IDEA.md held a real idea, a front-door build failure ending in a start-over link. Changed on branch local/bootstrap, not deployed and not verified live: evidence is seed/tests/test_happy_path.py (13 pass) and site/launchpath.test.mjs (18 pass) run in a cloud session on 2026-11-25; the live proof is the next tenant-repos run of deploy/launch-apps.mjs --probe.
